name: C-Suite Discovery & Executive Framing Playbook
description: AEs lacking deep domain expertise struggle to engage impatient C-level executives who resist standard discovery questions and demand peer-level strategic conversation.
buyer: Newly promoted or mid-market Account Executives selling to executive decision-makers
core_problem: AEs lacking deep domain expertise struggle to engage impatient C-level executives who resist standard discovery questions and demand peer-level strategic conversation.
desired_outcome: Confidently lead executive discovery calls using strategic business framing and domain-specific insights rather than generic product/BANT questions.
current_solutions: Practicing non-product related discovery scenarios with teammates
Reviewing recorded discovery calls of top performers
Limiting discovery to 2–3 high-level strategic questions
solution_gaps: Internal onboarding programs teach product feature specs, not executive business acumen.
Recorded top-performer calls are difficult to distill into repeatable tactical frameworks.
Generic opening hooks quickly break down when C-level buyers challenge rep domain knowledge.
possible_product: C-Level Discovery Battlecards & Domain Framing System
basis: New and experienced AEs struggle with executive resistance and lack the domain fluency required to run effective C-level discovery without falling back on basic scripts.

problems.statement: New or recently promoted Account Executives struggle to run effective discovery calls due to a lack of domain and product expertise.
problems.normalized_problem: Difficulty leading discovery calls due to limited domain and product knowledge
problems.desired_outcome: Lead credible, insightful discovery conversations early in a new AE role without getting derailed by technical gaps.
current_solutions: Practicing non-product related discovery scenarios with teammates
Reviewing recorded discovery calls of top performers
attempts: Giving premature advice or technical tips during the call to show value
solution_complaints: Standard onboarding material leaves new reps feeling ill-prepared when prospects ask detailed technical questions.

problems.statement: Account Executives find it difficult to engage cold or impatient C-level executives who resist standard discovery questioning.
problems.normalized_problem: Inability to hold effective discovery calls with executive and C-level buyers
problems.desired_outcome: Quickly establish authority and draw out strategic business priorities from senior executives.
current_solutions: Limiting discovery to 2–3 high-level strategic questions
attempts: Starting calls with icebreaker small talk
solution_complaints: Executive prospects become impatient or ice-cold when subjected to generic discovery questions.
